meetings.summary: The board continued a zipline appeal to January 28th and an MRC Partners LLC appeal to December 10th.

meetings.summary: Planning Commission splits recommendations on hotel rezoning bills.

meetings.headline: Committee weighs new criteria for Kīhei apartment district properties
meetings.summary: Committee weighs new criteria for Kīhei apartment district properties.

meetings.summary: The Arborist Committee heard a banyan tree update, planned exceptional tree measurements, and heard about fencing and replanting in the Kula burn scar.

meetings.headline: Commission on Persons with Disabilities

meetings.summary: Commissioners heard an informational presentation on removing tennis courts, a basketball court and a parking lot to prepare the royal complex for restoration.

meetings.summary: The committee heard testimony on two resolutions to rezone some apartment properties as hotel districts for vacation rentals, then recessed to August 19, 2026.

meetings.body: East Maui Water Board
meetings.headline: East Maui Water Board
meetings.summary: East Maui board hears of a $6 million draft West Maui water deal, picks state-meeting testifiers, and sets an August 17th Kula meeting.

meetings.body: Fire Commission
meetings.headline: Fire Commission
meetings.summary: The commission heard testimony on firefighter pay and voted to add the issue to next month's agenda; MEMA reported a $9.58 million budget.

meetings.body: Maui Board of Water Supply
meetings.headline: Maui Board of Water Supply
meetings.summary: Without a quorum, the Board of Water Supply heard the desalination report should be released by the next meeting, with public hearings in early August.

meetings.body: Lānaʻi Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Planning commission hears zoning rewrite and shoreline rules briefings
meetings.summary: Commissioners heard briefings on the zoning code rewrite and shoreline rules; new SMA minor permit rules head to the mayor for signature.

meetings.body: Maui Has 45,737 Kūpuna Over 60
meetings.headline: Maui Has 45,737 Kūpuna Over 60
meetings.summary: The Council on Aging heard about Lānaʻi home health care, a needs survey for the four-year plan, and an older adult's contractor fraud case.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission - Meeting of July 14, 2026
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission - Meeting of July 14, 2026
meetings.summary: The commission approved restrooms and showers at Mākena State Park, six to one, with a carrying capacity study due by July 31, 2029.

meetings.body: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The board met in closed session on an applicant's eligibility and heard the County Council passed, on first reading, an amendment to dissolve it.

meetings.body: Blind Advocate Challenges Maui County on Accessibility Gaps
meetings.headline: Blind Advocate Challenges Maui County on Accessibility Gaps
meetings.summary: The commission heard a talk on blindness and voted to explore a list of accessibility problems reported by the public.

meetings.body: Maui Arborist Committee
meetings.headline: Committee adds ʻulu tree and monkeypod grove to exceptional trees list
meetings.summary: The committee approved an ʻulu tree and 22 monkeypods as exceptional trees and heard testimony against a subdivision board's tree removal plan.

meetings.body: Maui Liquor Commission Debates Rule Changes to Help Struggling Restaurants
meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Commission Debates Rule Changes to Help Struggling Restaurants
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission met on Wednesday, July 8.

meetings.body: Maui Board of Ethics
meetings.headline: Maui Board of Ethics
meetings.summary: The Maui Board of Ethics approved two advisory opinions finding no conflicts and formed a working group to review Charter section 10-4.4.

meetings.body: Maui Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: Commissioners approved the old county courthouse renovation plans by voice vote.

meetings.body: Maui MPO TAC
meetings.headline: Maui MPO TAC
meetings.summary: Members approved the June 2, 2026 minutes by voice vote.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends Lahaina church rezoning bill as amended, 9-0
meetings.summary: The 9-0 vote covers Bill 94-2026, which would rezone Lahaina United Methodist Church land from R2 Residential to P1 Public/Quasi-Public, with acreage amended to 3.26. A land use zoning map and committee report are needed before first reading.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee weighs rezoning apartment properties for short-term rentals, recesses to July 6
meetings.summary: The committee closed oral testimony, with written testimony still accepted, and recessed until July 6, 2026 at 11 a.m. Affected properties would get letters if the resolutions pass, and the Planning Commission may hear the matter in mid or late September.

meetings.body: Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission met July 1, 2026, in person and online.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee reviews Spire Hawaiʻi fraud risk report, discusses direct pay at Water Supply
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed the fraud risk assessment, which found no nepotism policy and no countywide fraud complaint policy. The chair asked staff to send it to boards and commissions, and the committee next meets July 28, 2026 at 1:30 p.m.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Safe parking pilot site needs about five more months
meetings.summary: The committee heard the Safe Parking Pilot site needs about five months of work, and it deferred the item.

meetings.body: Lumeria Maui Appeal Continued to September
meetings.headline: Lumeria Maui appeal hearing delayed for more settlement talks
meetings.summary: The Board of Variance and Appeals delayed the Lumeria Maui appeal hearing so both sides can try one more settlement conference.

meetings.body: Molokaʻi Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Planning commission approves home exemption; chair raises water capacity questions
meetings.summary: The commission approved an SMA exemption for a single-family home after the chair questioned water and wastewater capacity in the subdivision.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends passage of energy contract financing, discusses grant rules
meetings.summary: The committee voted to recommend passage, as amended, of a resolution to finance a Johnson Controls Inc. energy contract by lease purchase. On the grants rules bill, staff will ask the administration when rulemaking is required.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission Defers Mākena State Park SMA Permit
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission Defers Mākena State Park SMA Permit
meetings.summary: The Maui Planning Commission adopted a written decision 5–2, denied a late petition to intervene, and deferred the Mākena State Park permit to July 14.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meetings.headline: Committee recommends council adopt resolution on lawsuit settlements and special counsel bills
meetings.summary: The committee voted 6–0 to recommend the full council adopt a resolution sending all settlement offers to the council and having Council Services attorneys review special counsel's bills. It moves to the full council; the next meeting covers an auditors' fraud risk report.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Meeting
meetings.summary: The Council adopted a Pride Month resolution with nine ayes and zero noes and heard a request to buy land for a new upcountry well.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discharges claims resolution without recommendation, acts on two others
meetings.summary: Members voted 9-0 to send the claims resolution to the full council without a recommendation and 9-0 to recommend passing the computation of time resolution. Filing was recommended for transfer of appropriations. Most likely on the July 7th agenda.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses 2026 storm recovery, SBA loans and Kīhei gulch sediment; item deferred
meetings.summary: The committee took up DRIP 9.4 on long-term recovery from the 2026 storms, including SBA loans, 92 damaged County sites and about $100 million in damages. The item was deferred without objection.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meetings.headline: Planning staff update council committee on zoning code rewrite
meetings.summary: Planning staff updated the committee on the Title 19 zoning code rewrite, begun in 2019, and the item was deferred.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses bill on housing funds for houseless residents, likely to defer
meetings.summary: The housing director said the department would work with a nonprofit partner, suggested softer wording than "ensure," and noted no fiscal year 27 funds are set aside. The chair said the bill will likely be deferred, and a safe parking program will be discussed June 29th.

meetings.body: Maui Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission sets open search for personnel director
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission voted to fill the personnel services director job through open recruitment and formed a working group to plan hiring.

meetings.body: Liquor Board Fines Southshore Tiki Lounge $4,000 for Minor Sale
meetings.headline: Liquor Board Fines Southshore Tiki Lounge $4,000 for Minor Sale
meetings.summary: The board fined Southshore Tiki Lounge $2,000 on each of two counts after it pleaded no contest to serving a minor decoy.

meetings.body: Maui County Council
meetings.headline: Council welcomes Fukuyama sister city delegation
meetings.summary: The Maui County Council welcomed a Fukuyama City delegation with speeches, music, hula, lei and gifts honoring the sister city relationship.

meetings.body: Liquor Board Fines Pāʻia Fish Market $5,000 for Serving Minor
meetings.headline: Liquor board fines fish market restaurant for serving a minor
meetings.summary: The board fined a fish market restaurant $2,000 and $3,000 on two counts after a cashier served beer to a 19-year-old decoy.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses shoreline erosion impacts on coastal properties; chair proposes deferral
meetings.summary: The committee's only agenda item was shoreline erosion, with presentations and public testimony. The chair said the item would be deferred if there were no objections; no member response is recorded in the facts.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers energy contract item, takes up Bill 181 homeowner exemption increase
meetings.summary: The chair postponed the Johnson Controls Inc. energy performance contract. On Bill 181 (2025), which would raise two property tax exemptions, the chair asked about deferring, and a motion to file and its second were withdrawn. No final action is stated.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.summary: YouthLine Hawaiʻi described its youth crisis line, presenters proposed a youth campus on golf course land, and both items were deferred.

meetings.body: Housing Advisory Board
meetings.headline: Housing board adjourns early over Sunshine Law concern
meetings.summary: Housing board adjourns early over Sunshine Law concern.

meetings.body: Maui Fire Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Fire Commission
meetings.summary: The Fire and Public Safety Commission re-elected its chair and heard salary and emergency management updates before audio problems ended the meeting.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee sends vehicle noise fine bill to full council
meetings.summary: The committee voted to send Bill 119-2025, which would raise fines for loud vehicle sound systems, to the full council.

meetings.body: Maui Police Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Police Commission
meetings.summary: The Maui Police Commission heard an undercover operation led to four arrests and voted to seek a 5% raise for the chief.

meetings.body: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission elected officers, found a hotel restaurant renovation exempt from a coastal-zone permit, and heard training on planning and open-meetings law.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses Bill 76 water fee change and an overnight parking ban
meetings.summary: The committee discussed Bill 76, which would base the water system development fee on daily water use rather than meter size, and took testimony on a parking ban. The chair said the parking bill will return with Public Works, police and Human Concerns present.

meetings.body: 'Aha Wai o Maui Hikina East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meetings.headline: Board briefed on state hearing over ditch system ownership
meetings.summary: The board heard a briefing on a state land board meeting about the ditch system, adopted the director's evaluation, and went into closed session.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee removed police radio project funding, raised the small-grant limit to $30,000, and lowered the emergency fund by $32 million.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee heard testimony on Tutu and Me, housing and water rates, and approved a coral reef grant condition with eight ayes.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee weighs cuts, housing bonds; wastewater cut fails 4–4
meetings.summary: Testifiers urged Tutu and Me preschool funding; a motion to delete a village wastewater project's funding failed 4–4; domestic violence housing bonds passed.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed water and management budgets, including $176 million in water projects and $21 million for temporary housing, then deferred the item.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee takes up fiscal year 27 budget, hearing fire, housing and public testimony
meetings.summary: The committee reviewed the proposed fiscal year 27 County of Maui budget, with the fire chief reporting a 0.6% increase and the housing department asking for $4.4 million more for rental assistance. The chair closed public testimony and accepted written testimony.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meetings.headline: Committee defers Aloha House care item and East Maui Water Authority budget review
meetings.summary: The committee deferred both items without objection: Aloha House's substance abuse care, and the East Maui Water Authority's operations and fiscal year 2026 budget. The authority's director said a capacity update is due in the next couple of weeks.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meetings.headline: Water committee defers Bill 108 on USGS water monitoring agreement
meetings.summary: The committee discussed Bill 108 (2025), a joint funding agreement with USGS for Oct. 1, 2025 to Sept. 30, 2026 that also funds a West Maui monitoring well site study. The chair deferred the item; the bill still needs second and final reading.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Budget committee reviews emergency agency plan, hears public testimony
meetings.summary: The committee heard the emergency management agency's 2026 budget request and public testimony, and the chair deferred the item without decisions.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.summary: In fiscal year 2026 budget talks, the fire chief said a $15 million Haʻikū Fire Station grant was lost, and planning cited uncompetitive salaries.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meetings.headline: Committee passes Bill 32 on first reading, defers grant overview and budget procedures
meetings.summary: Bill 32 passed first reading, eight ayes with one excused. The committee deferred the federal disaster recovery grant overview and budget procedures. The Mayor's budget is due March 25, and committee budget deliberations begin March 31.

meetings.body: Maui County Salary Commission Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Salary Commission Meeting
meetings.summary: The Salary Commission heard a draft County of Maui salary study from MGT Consulting and voted to move its March meeting to March 28.

meetings.body: Hana Advisory Committee to the Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Hāna committee backs land change for clinic housing and specialty clinic
meetings.summary: The committee voted five in favor to recommend approval of a land change for Hāna Health workforce housing and a specialty clinic.

meetings.body: Maui County Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.headline: Maui County Commission on Children & Youth
meetings.summary: The commission chose five posters for buses and voted to have the vice chair write a letter of support to the Budget and Finance committee.

meetings.body: E. Maui Regional Board (Water Authority)
meetings.headline: E. Maui Regional Board (Water Authority)
meetings.summary: The East Maui Regional Board named its chair and vice chair to any East Maui irrigation system negotiations and adopted a motto.

meetings.body: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission approved an SMA exemption for Molokaʻi Community Health Center's renovations and heard an update on the Molokaʻi landfill.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission approved two restaurant liquor licenses, including Star Noodle's post-wildfire move, and deferred the director's evaluation to January.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Ethics
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Ethics
meetings.summary: The Board of Ethics voted on two requests for ethics advice and met in a closed-door session.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission - South Maui Plan
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission - South Maui Plan
meetings.summary: Reviewing the South Maui Community Plan, the Maui Planning Commission voted down two map motions for the Maui Research and Technology Park.

meetings.body: Maui County Council On Aging
meetings.headline: Maui County Council On Aging
meetings.summary: The Council on Aging approved its August 13 minutes, but a motion to approve its plan report stalled without a quorum.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission voted to recommend amending, not deleting, a water condition on a West Maui housing project.

meetings.body: Maui County Animal Control Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Animal Control Board
meetings.summary: The Animal Control Board voted unanimously to remove past contested case minutes and hearing records from its County web page.

meetings.body: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: The commission put off a decision on Imua Family Services' preschool plan and approved plans for two homes rebuilt after the 2023 fire.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Adjudication Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Adjudication Board
meetings.summary: The liquor board fined two restaurants: $1,000 with $750 suspended, and $2,000 on each of two counts.

meetings.body: Maui County Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Commission approves minutes, hears evaluation, union and budget updates
meetings.summary: The commission approved its November 6, 2024 minutes and heard updates on the director's review, union contract talks and the budget.

meetings.body: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board reviewed 2025 nomination applicants in closed session and chose people to interview, including for the Housing Advisory Board.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meetings.summary: The Maui County Board of Ethics formed a group to review its gift guide and approved a press release on confidentiality.

meetings.body: MPO Policy Board
meetings.headline: MPO Policy Board
meetings.summary: The board approved a full 2045 transportation plan update with work extended to mid-April and agreed with state road classification reports.

meetings.body: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Lanai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The Lānaʻi Planning Commission voted to start a parking code change and heard legal limits on proposed commissioner talk-story sessions.

meetings.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.summary: Fire officials reported over $890,000 in first FEMA checks, and the commission voted to support the fire department's budget in a letter to the mayor.

meetings.body: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness
meetings.headline: Maui County Commission on Healing Solutions for Homelessness
meetings.summary: The commission heard recommendations on involving faith-based groups, elected its chair and vice chair, and learned a homeless strategic plan draft is due December 20.

meetings.body: Maui County Board of Water Supply
meetings.headline: Maui County Board of Water Supply
meetings.summary: The Board of Water Supply heard a West Maui groundwater briefing, put off a draft letter, reviewed capital projects, and approved its 2025 schedule.

meetings.body: Maui County Police Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Police Commission
meetings.summary: The commission heard a call to dismiss the police chief, voted on its budget letter, and set its next meeting for December 18.

meetings.body: Maui County Committee on the Status of Women
meetings.headline: Maui County Committee on the Status of Women
meetings.summary: Staff confirmed enough members were present to hold the meeting.

meetings.body: Maui County Commission on Children and Youth
meetings.headline: Maui County Commission on Children and Youth
meetings.summary: The commission reviewed sample Talking Is Teaching bus posters and heard its budget cannot cover printing while donation rules are researched.

meetings.body: East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meetings.headline: East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meetings.summary: Members voted on a fiscal year 2026 budget request to the mayor and passed a motion letting members testify for the board.

meetings.body: Maui County Cost of Government
meetings.headline: Commission reviews board nominations, plans study of county boards
meetings.summary: Commission reviews board nominations, plans study of county boards.

meetings.body: Maui County Committee on Persons with Disabilities
meetings.headline: Maui County Committee on Persons with Disabilities
meetings.summary: With only four members present at first, the commission agreed to hear presentations but not vote.

meetings.body: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Liquor Control Commission
meetings.summary: Roy's Limited Partnership No. 2 asked to allow drinking in set areas of its golf courses.

meetings.body: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Molokai Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission unanimously approved a home renovation project and moved its December 11 meeting to 1 p.m.

meetings.body: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board was called to order on November 13 at 4:45 p.m.

meetings.body: Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee Meeting
meetings.summary: The committee approved urban boundary and road classification updates and heard a proposal to extend the transportation plan update to March.

meetings.body: Maui County Cost of Government Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Cost of Government Commission
meetings.summary: The commission approved draft minutes, backed a 15% budget increase request, and deferred a West Maui Greenway study group so its scope can be refined.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission
meetings.summary: The commission backed a lot's rezoning to residential and allowed limited discovery in the Kahana Sunset appeal.

meetings.body: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission
meetings.summary: The commission was called to order at 11:10 a.m.

meetings.body: Civil Service Commission
meetings.headline: Commission delays in-person meetings, hears update on empty seats
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission set April 2025 as a tentative date to meet in person and learned two empty seats will stay open.

meetings.body: Maui County Public Works Commission
meetings.headline: Maui County Public Works Commission
meetings.summary: The Public Works Commission conditionally approved street names, chose its 2025 chair and vice chair, and kept Wednesday 1:30 p.m. meetings.

meetings.body: Maui County Police Commission Meeting
meetings.headline: Maui County Police Commission Meeting
meetings.summary: The Police Commission voted to send letters to the mayor about an investigator job and to the salary commission about the chief's pay.

meetings.body: Molokai Planning Commission Meeting
meetings.headline: Molokaʻi commission denies exemption for home demolition
meetings.summary: The commission denied an exemption for demolishing a two-story home after questions about landfill disposal and the site went unanswered.

meetings.body: Maui Planning Commission Meeting - South Maui Plan
meetings.headline: Maui Planning Commission Meeting - South Maui Plan
meetings.summary: The Maui Planning Commission heard testimony on the South Maui Community Plan, including the Promenade property, and took no action.

meetings.body: Maui County Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.headline: Fire commission hears evacuation software plans and budget process briefing
meetings.summary: The commission heard about new evacuation software, approved its minutes, heard housing safety concerns, and learned how the fire budget works.

meetings.body: Maui County Arborist Committee Meeting
meetings.headline: Arborist Committee plans December tree-measuring visit
meetings.summary: The Arborist Committee approved August minutes, planned a December tree-measuring visit, and set its next meeting for November 13, 2024.

meetings.body: Maui County Council Disaster, Resilience, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meetings.headline: Committee discusses West Maui plan and water limits on housing
meetings.summary: The committee discussed West Maui Community Plan updates after the 2023 wildfires, heard how water limits housing, and deferred the draft resolution.

meetings.body: Upcountry Maui County Dept. of Water Supply Conservation Plan Meeting
meetings.headline: Upcountry residents weigh in on water conservation plan
meetings.summary: The Department of Water Supply presented a proposed Upcountry water conservation plan aiming for 20% savings by 2040, and residents asked about water meters.
